slice: Bind reported GitHub object verification into Cloudflare research evidence ingestion before promotion.

verification.execution_mode: local exact-copy verification of committed source and dependencies
verified_behaviors: Any unverified reported repository object blocks promotion before Pages evidence evaluation.
Valid object provenance cannot bypass rejected Pages evidence.
Promotion is permitted only when both object provenance and Pages evidence pass.

limits: The test was not executed in GitHub Actions.
No Cloudflare Pages deployment was created or inspected in this slice.
The verifier trusts the supplied authenticated observation envelope; observation acquisition remains a separate responsibility.
An empty reported_objects list is explicit and accepted only when the independent Pages evidence verifier passes.
